explanation: datasets.ts corrects text for four studies against their GEO records and papers: GSE248462 time-series design (hepatocyte Nr1d1/Nr1d2, three pools per arm and timepoint), GSE160802 citation (lean mice, IP118 and PY115 coadministered), GSE246918 name and citation (hypothalamus) and GSE162563 name, citation and baseline label (GnRH-depleted supernatant, mixed control group). reviewedTrackLabels.ts becomes a per-dataset table that also corrects the GSE246918 and GSE162563 track labels at display time, and loadDatasetMeta.ts asks that table which datasets need it instead of naming one id; ids, region, preparation, contrasts and bundle bytes are unchanged.
